B&B FAQs
View the rest of our FAQs or contact us directly.
Do all rates include breakfast?
No, to give our guests more flexibility (and keep our rates as accessible as possible), we now offer two options:
Room-Only Rate: Does not include breakfast, perfect for early risers or budget-conscious travelers.
Breakfast Rate: Includes our signature hot breakfast delivered to your suite at 8:00 or 9:00 AM.
You can also add breakfast later if you change your mind; we just ask for 24 hours’ notice.
Do you have a loyalty program for returning guests?
We do! Repeat guests who let us know they’re returning get a little extra love, such as complimentary weekend breakfasts or welcome cookies on weekday arrivals. If you’ve stayed with us before, just drop us a quick note so we can make sure you’re flagged in our system.
Do you have vegetarian, gluten free, or vegan breakfasts?
Yes! We regularly serve gluten free, vegan, and vegetarian meals, and other requests. Just be sure to call us at 479-253-7409 and tell us, so that we are sure to know.
Many of our dishes come naturally gluten free, as well as vegetarian, however we are able to accommodate almost any diet. Please remind us during check-in so we can get the proper ingredients! Note: Optional hot breakfast available with the Cliff Cottage Breakfast Rate or as an add-on. Delivered to your suite at 8:00 or 9:00 AM.
Do you offer any packages or optional extras?
Yes, we offer a variety of optional extras and packages for any occasion. Romance, girls trips, birthdays, anniversaries. Call for our optional extras: 479-253-7409
We offer several packages to make your stay more special, including, chocolate covered strawberries, pillow roses, long stemmed roses in a vase, we also accommodate custom requests, please contact us before check-in to arrange them!
How close are you to downtown?
We are in the heart of Downtown, just 17 steps away from main street. We are located at one end of the privately owned retail shops, restaurants, and bars.
​
What is your cancellation policy?
We are able to cancel the reservation up to 5 days in advance with no penalty. Within 5 days of arrival the cancelation fee is equal to one night stay.
In the unfortunate situation we need to cancel within 4 days, it is inn policy to keep the room deposit (the equivalent of 1 night stay) due to the uncertainty of renting the room again.
When is check-in time and when is check-out?
In order to give our staff ample time to bring the room to standard we request check-out at 11:00am, check-in is 3:00pm.
Early & late checkout is often available upon request however it is not guaranteed that we can honor it, but we will strive to accommodate all requests we can.
Where should we go for lunch?
For lunch we recommend Local Flavor, which offers upscale dining at a reasonable price.
For a more casual dining, we recommend New Delhi Cafe.
Both restaurants are a short walk.

About Cliff Cottage Inn
Experience a magical rejuvenating Eurekan getaway at the Cliff Cottage Inn. Located right downtown, you will discover 7 upscale unique boutique suites that take you back to another era, while providing modern amenities, heartfelt customer service, and cuisine that delights.
About the property
Cliff Cottage Inn is located just 17 steps from Downtown Main Street. The campus at our Inn consists of 7 unique upscale jacuzzi suites (one is a hot tub), two Victorian buildings, two Craftsman buildings, a garden, and enough parking for one downtown off-street parking spot per reservation.
Each of our Suites are named after famous writers and other artists from 100 to 200 years ago. To find out more about these authors and artists, click on the following links of our unique upscale Suites.
Bernhardt (King)
Colette (Queen)
Dickinson (King)
Stevenson (King)
Tennyson (King)
Thoreau (Queen)
Zelda s (King)
Creating Extraordinary Eurekan Experiences
At the Cliff Cottage Inn downtown Eureka Springs, our purpose is to help our guests create magical, restorative, uniquely Eurekan getaways that help our guests live more personally rewarding lives, have a more positive impact on the communities around them, and build cherished memories.
We create these restorative experiences for our guests, by embracing the best of Eureka Springs, setting the stage for our guest s adventures, providing heartfelt customer service, and delivering inspiring cuisine that delights.
In order to embody the best of Eureka Springs, we celebrate inclusivity, nature, art, artisanal craftsmanship, outdoor adventure, mysticism, and the turn of the 20th century.
Travelers Choice 2026
Cliff Cottage Inn is a 2026 Travelers Choice award winner on TripAdvisor, an honor earned entirely through the reviews our guests leave over the course of a year. Thank you to everyone who took the time to write one.
All Are Welcome Here
Cliff Cottage Inn is committed to creating a warm, welcoming space for every guest, regardless of background, identity, or orientation. Eureka Springs has a long tradition of celebrating diversity, and we are proud to carry that spirit forward. Everyone deserves a magical getaway.
Justin Robins, Innkeeper
About Justin
Justin has been working toward this life since he was a teenager, when he first imagined running a boutique inn of his own. That ambition led him to business school at UNC Chapel Hill, an MBA in hospitality from Cornell s Hotel School, and a management training program at The Venetian in Las Vegas.
After nearly a decade in corporate finance, he found his way to Cliff Cottage Inn in Eureka Springs, where he has now run the inn full-time for nine years. In that time, he has renovated every property, grown occupancy from 28% to over 70%, and built an operation grounded in care, intention, and attention to detail.
Cliff Cottage Inn is his life s work, and it comes through in every stay.

Frequently Asked Questions
Reset
Showing 33 of 33
Are children welcome?
No children under the age of 12 are allowed to stay at the Cliff Cottage Inn. This is to maintain our romantic atmosphere and because of our antique furnishings.
This is because of our cliff side location, antique décor, and to maintain our romantic "adult" atmosphere.
Are there any good bars, nightlife, or live entertainment?
Live music can be found at Chelseas, the Gravel Bar, the Auditorium, and Gotahold Brewery.
Also, check out Brews, Stonehouse wine bar, Eureka Live, and the Cathouse Lounge.
Are there restaurants close by?
Yes! We are right downtown and have several fine dining and more casual restaurants within walking distance, plus several more great options within a short drive.
For a fine dining experience we recommend Le Stick 479-981-3123. It’s French cuisine in a romantic atmosphere with excellent wine pairings and service.
For a good steak, we recommend the Grotto (upscale, higher price range, very romantic) 479-363-6431.
For something very close to the Inn, we recommend Local Flavor. It’s right across the street, delicious American style food in the upper-mid price range. Excellent outdoor seating and views. 479-253-9522.
For outstanding Italian food, we recommend Ermilios. They are located in an authentic Victorian home in the historic home district. Upper-mid price range. They don t take reservations and are very popular, so going real early or real late can cut down the wait time on a busy day.
For pizza, we really enjoy Reds Pizza. It’s a bit pricey but very good and they have a lovely deck to enjoy the natural beauty of Eureka. 479-244-7170.
Another casual restaurant in the mid price range within walking distance is New Delhi Cafe. You will find more affordable burger, great loaded fries, and an awesome Reuben sandwich here. Most Friday - Sunday afternoons / evenings there is live music. (479) 253-2525
Late night snack? Almost all the restaurants close by 9pm. The CatHouse lounge is just down the road and serves heavy hors d oeuvres until midnight. (479) 363-9976.
Can I check-in early?
Check-in is officially at 3:00pm, but you may park starting at 11:00am. Also, you can give us a call before arrival and we will see how far along our team is on preparing your Suite.
Can I leave my car parked in my spot after check-out time?
After check-out, you may leave your car parked until 2pm, while you enjoy the town a bit more.
Can I park my car if I arrive earlier?
You may park your car and enjoy the downtown as early as 11:00am on the day of your check in.
We try to accommodate every parking request due to Eureka s Victorian infrastructure we are sometimes totally full.
Can we bring more than one car?
Each Suite comes with one, but only one, designated off-street parking spot. If your party has more than one vehicle, then call us at 479-253-7409 and we will help find parking.
Due to the nature of the town it is requested our guests bring the smallest vehicle available for the stay, Unfortunately Eureka was designed with horses in mind, not hummers!
Can you accommodate personal diets and food allergies?
Yes! Cliff Cottage Inn s curated menu can be easily adjusted to fit any dietary restrictions. Just be sure to call us at 479-253-7409 and tell us, so that we are sure to know.
Absolutely! Many of our dishes come naturally gluten free, as well as vegetarian, however we are able to accommodate almost any diet.

Do you allow pets?
Pets are not permitted on property. This is to maintain our romantic atmosphere and because of our antique furnishings.
Our rooms are furnished with genuine midcentury antiques, due to the fragility of the furnishings, we request for no pets on property to maintain our ambiance.
